_doc: spx-06 director data: replace types.umbral_snare.variants[<biome>].pressure in data/special_encounters.json and its staged copy (spec/peer_benchmark/staged/spx/special_encounters.json, which must stay byte-identical to the catalog) with these objects.

earth.text: Each round, Rubble rises on one tile of your shortest way out.

fire.text: Fire spreads one row from the entry each round.

air.text: A headwind slides everyone 1 tile toward the entry at the end of your turn.

ice.text: The tile in front of each sealing door is Ice.

lightning.text: Crossing a live tether hurts and Shocks you.

shadow.text: The Umbra closes in: every two rounds, your sight shrinks by 1.
